title: STEP AFTER STEP, HE LED THEM ON

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: They left Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah. They left Haradah and camped at Makheloth. They left Makheloth and camped at Tahath. They left Tahath and camped at Terah. They left Terah and camped at Mithkah. They left Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah. They left Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth. They left Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan. They left Bene Jaakan and camped at Hor Haggidgad. - Num 33:24-32 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
More camps, more moving on. Haradah, Makheloth, Tahath, Terah, and the rest — names we cannot place on a map with certainty, marking journeys we know nothing about. Yet the steady refrain continues: "They left... and camped... They left... and camped." Over and over, the people packed up and moved, following God's leading from one place to the next.

There is a quiet lesson in this repetition. The Christian life is often lived in exactly this rhythm — moving forward one step at a time, not knowing the whole route, simply following as God leads. We rarely see the full map of our lives. We are given enough light for the next step, and we are asked to trust the One who sees the whole journey.

Israel was led by the cloud by day and the fire by night. When the cloud moved, they moved; when it settled, they settled. Their job was not to plan the itinerary but to follow their God. That is our calling too: to walk by faith, following the Lord's leading even when we cannot see far ahead.

We may not always understand why we are being led through certain "camps" — certain seasons, situations, or waiting places. But we can trust the character of the One leading us. Jesus said, "I am the way" (John 14:6), and He leads His sheep who know His voice (John 10:27). Step after step, He is faithfully bringing us home. Keep following.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you willing to follow God one step at a time without seeing the whole route?
2. What "camp" is God asking you to move on from, or to stay in for now?
3. How can you grow in trusting the One who sees the whole journey?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I cannot see the whole road ahead, but I trust You to lead me step by step. Give me a heart that follows Your leading faithfully, resting in Jesus who is the way home. Amen.
